The electric computer-based role was offered by companies.
Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is fabulous, and the library is the best. It is a clean and neat place with silence. Food served is best in the hostel because every time there is a different item in a week, and on Sunday a good meal is served to students.
Faculty: Teachers in our college have good knowledge about particular chapters, and we can easily understand them. The teaching quality is the best, and you also get extra time in the evening so that you can clear your doubts from teachers. Students are satisfied with the faculty members.
Other: I chose this course because it was my dream to be an engineer since childhood and do some new inventions through electric material in India. There is nothing to improve on campus, but they need to speed up their studies. All events are held successfully in this college.

Ankit Kumar

4.2
5Placements4Infrastructure3Faculty5Crowd & Campus Life4Value for Money
Overall, everything is excellent on this campus.
Placements: Placements of our college are the best in the country. The placement statistics are improving every year, and around 85% of the students got placed in on-campus placements in 2019-2020. The highest salary package offered was 1.47 crore per annum in 2020. Placements were offered by companies like Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Samsung, Adobe, etc.
Infrastructure: The hostel facility is good and well maintained, and the hostel is compulsory for every student. In 1st and 2nd-year, rooms are 3 sharing based, while in 3rd-year, rooms are 2 sharing based. In the final year, there are single sharing rooms. The hostel fee is around Rs. 12,000 per semester, excluding mess charge. There is a huge sports complex.
Faculty: Faculty members were top-notch here, but few courses were outdated and required to be upgraded. The course curriculum was student-centric, which lets students choose the course which they want to do. There were many electives to choose from, and students can choose courses from other departments as well. I took many courses from humanity and B.Tech computer engineering.
Other: There are many scholarships for students like merit-cum-means, KVPY Aditya Birla scholarship, etc.
Reviewed on 12 May 2021Read More

The college has really good academics, good infrastructure and facilities.
Placements: Placements are good as compared to the other IITs except for a few. Internship opportunities are enough for 80-90% of the students during my time in the college. Packages offered are above average for mechanical students. Overall, it will be a good experience for you.
Infrastructure: Living conditions in the new hostel are very good, but in old hostels, it is not that good. Mess facilities are good in both new and old hostels. Wi-Fi speed is awesome, and canteen food is very tasty. The hostel life is very good. Enough sports facilities are available.
Faculty: Professors are excellent. The teaching quality is above average in the first year. But it is excellent in the latter years which is more important. The course curriculum is a bit hectic, but it is changing this year. The curriculum is more theoretical than making you industry-ready.
Other: I wanted an IIT near to my home, so I decided to get in it. I chose mechanical because my rank allowed me to do that only. But now, I don't regret it. Overall, I am happy with my 3 years in this college.

Akshay Jain
B.Tech. in Biological Science and Bioengineering - Batch of 2023
4.4
3Placements5Infrastructure5Faculty5Crowd & Campus Life4Value for Money
College life at IITK is excellent.
Placements: Placements, in general, are very good. Around 80% of the students got selected in core jobs, software jobs, consulting, finance, product management, etc. In our course, the highest salary package offered is 35 LPA, and around 50% of the students got selected for this salary package. Others went for higher studies. The minimum salary package offered is around 7 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 11 LPA. Top recruiters are mostly software-based companies. Around 70% of the students got an internship.
Infrastructure: Our department building has multiple labs with high-tech lab equipment. It has the best drinking water facility on the whole campus, and the Wi-Fi connection is also fast. Classrooms are also well-furnished with air-conditioners and projectors. The library here is big, but if you forgot your ID card, you might not be allowed to enter the library. The hostel is well-furnished and clean. The quality of food is also good, but the taste is somewhat compromising. The canteen is very good, and you can sit with friends and enjoy the good food. Medical facilities are sufficiently good for normal treatment. IITKs sports and games facilities are excellent among all other IITs. We have squash, badminton, volleyball, tennis, table tennis, cricket, football, wall climbing, swimming, gymnastics, hockey, weight lifting, athletics, and many others like pool tables, etc.
Faculty: Teachers here are well-experienced and achieved excellent awards in academics. Some of them are members of different academic societies, and they are very helpful. The teaching material is very good. The course curriculum is well-designed, and it is very relevant. According to the students' interests, there are many opportunities, including a career in industries.
Other: I have chosen this course mainly because of the rank cutoffs in the JoSAA. Still, after studying, I started to like this course mainly because of the different opportunities it offers. Biological sciences have a profound impact on any discipline. I would like if students were taught more about businesses. Many seminars and thesis get presented, and many other entrepreneur cell meets and fests happen every year. The campus crowd is not much, but it is also not very less. Every student gets sufficiently bonded with others. There is a village surrounding our campus. Different scholarships are offered to the students, and there is no end to extracurricular activities.
Reviewed on 26 Feb 2021Read More

You can have the best experience here.

Internship opportunities are shared very often among the student community, and students can surely get internships easily.

Faculty: The teachers here are very knowledgeable and helpful. Most of them are at least PhD holders. They have a very vast knowledge and experience in their field. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students more than industry-ready. Academics at IITK are treated very seriously. Continuous evaluation is followed here with quizzes at least every 2 weeks.
Other: I chose this course as I have an interest in machines and their related things. Getting admission to such a prestigious university was great. The annual cultural fest organised at IITK is Antaragini, and the tech fest is Techkriti, which is Aisa's one of the hugest fests. IIT Kanpur is one of the best colleges in India in terms of academics.
Placements: Placements at IIT Kanpur are amazing. Top companies like Google and Microsoft recruit students from our course. In the year 2020, a student from our course got placed with the highest salary package of 1.5 crores per annum. The average salary package offered in the civil department is around 13 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is about 5 LPA. Approximately 20% of the students easily got internships.
Infrastructure: Classrooms at IIT Kanpur are equipped with air-conditioners, Wi-Fi and every sophisticated thing. Even most of the labs are equipped with air-conditioners at IIT Kanpur. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, so you can access the Wi-Fi from any corner of IIT Kanpur. Quality of the food served in the mess is average. However, the breakfast is quite good, but this is not the same case with lunch and dinner.
Faculty: Professors at IIT Kanpur are amazing, but their teaching is research-oriented. There are not going to spoon-feed you like the coaching teachers. However, they are well-experienced and have a wide range of knowledge. The professor like HC Verma, also teaches students at IIT Kanpur.
Other: The crowd at IIT Kanpur is amazing. You can get an opportunity to interact with India's greatest minds. IIT Kanpur organises India's one of the greatest fests like Antaragni, Techkriti and Udghosh. IIT Kanpur has a very lush green campus, and it also has facilities to play every sport.

Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.
Placements: About 90% of the students get placed in tech companies. About 10% of students choose to pursue core courses or opt for higher studies. The highest salary package offered in BSBE department is approximately 41 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 6 LPA. Tech companies always offer the highest salary packages. One of the important things is that students from our department only made India's first COVID-19 ventilator. It was made by Nocca Robotics on our campus. About 60% of the students got internships in non-core companies, while 20% of the students got internships in core companies. Few students got a chance in foreign universities to do internships.
Infrastructure: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled with a speed of around 400 Mbps. You will enjoy mess food as it is very delicious. There are more clubs and sports, and the campus is huge than you expect. In the hostels, floors are known as wings. You can choose any branch as all are good.
Faculty: Teachers here are gold medalists. Many of them have done a PhD and masters in technology. Professors are very good, and they are always available to help you in any condition. You will be provided with a student guide in your first year, who is your senior. They will help you in academics and non-academic works.

5Placements5Infrastructure4Faculty5Crowd & Campus Life5Value for Money
It is a really good college for the overall development of students.
Placements: Nearly 95% of the students who attended placements got a job offer from at least one company. But not all of them accepted the offer as some of them have other plans, while some considered that salary packages offered to them are not on par with their skill set. However, around 80% of the students accepted jobs eventually. Many of them already have pre-placement offers from various companies in which they did internships. The highest salary package offered was 1.5 crores per annum, but the maximum of only 2-3 students got it. Most of them offered with the salary package ranging from 15 LPA to 30 LPA. The lowest salary package offered to students varies from 6 LPA to 10 LPA.
Infrastructure: Since it is a fairly huge campus, it is not completely Wi-Fi enabled. Only academic buildings have a Wi-Fi facility. The speed of the internet is really awesome, particularly with LAN cable, which is available in every room. The infrastructure is really good as classrooms are equipped with projectors and other teaching aids which are required. The maintenance is also good. PK Kelkar Library is a renounced library with books for the entire curriculum, and it contains a maximum of 2-3 copies of every book. Hostels are also well maintained or lavish. The mess serves better food than the food served in PGs or hostels outside, but it is not similar to the food prepared at our homes. However, overall, hostels are good, and the infrastructure is awesome.
Faculty: Professors here are knowledgeable in their respective fields, but they are not highly skilled to teach the same. Many lectures are not interesting, and students feel bored during the same as well. But such lectures are barely around 15% to 20%. Most lectures are good, and some are really interesting as well. The course curriculum is not perfect. However, it is way better than the course curriculum of UGC affiliated universities, and it includes practical topics and is designed later than universities. It helps in the industry, but every student has to try on their own mostly. Overall, it is pretty good with just minor flaws.
Other: Our college culture is really good and helps every student to grow in all ways who wish to develop.

Every hostel has a mess and a separate Canteen to cater to the food requirements of the hostellers. The medical facilities are handled for free for all the students by the Health Centre, IITK. IIT Kanpur boasts one of the best facilities for Sports and Games among all IITs and has won the Inter-IIT sports meet 3 times in the last 10 years.
Faculty: The Professors are highly qualified and are graduates from top universities around the world themselves. The course curriculum is very well organized to first give the basic knowledge about Material Sciences and then introduce them to the advanced topics. The curriculum is also quite flexible as we get to select our Electives from our choice, both from our departmental courses and other department courses.

B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023

4Placements4Infrastructure4Faculty5Crowd & Campus Life4Value for Money
It is the best college to explore and get good placements and great campus life.
Placements: Almost 85% of the students get placed from ME course from IITK. The highest salary package offered varies every year, and it depends on your talent and skills. In the previous year, one civil engineering student got a salary package of 1.5 crores per annum, which was more than the average salary package offered for CSE at IITK. In ME, the highest salary packages are offered, and they range from 40 LPA-50 LPA. However, most of the students opt for non-core jobs as more number of software companies visit the campus and offer more salary packages than core companies. You can do a project under any professor, and irrespective of your branch, you just have to approach the professor. You should have the enthusiasm to explore and learn.
Infrastructure: The library is well equipped with more than 2 lacs books. The library is generally open from 8:00 am to 12:00 am, but during exams, it is open round the clock. The library is air-conditioned. Moreover, you have NCL and CC, which are equipped with computers. In IITK, there are currently 20 lecture halls, and they all are well-maintained with projectors, air-conditioners, etc. Facilities of the hostel depend on the hostel in which you stay. Mostly, hostels are good. The quality of the food served in the mess is average, but you have CCD, Mama-Mia and canteens to eat food. IITK has health centre called HC which offers you medical facilities around the year, and you can visit there in case of emergency. IITK also has great sports culture, and in the first year, you have to do physical exercise compulsorily. About 75% attendance is mandatory in PE, and you can also play a particular game as a CPA and can explore that game.
Faculty: Faculty members here are well-qualified, and many of them are graduated from foreign universities. Their teaching quality is just awesome. Moreover, none of the professors will deny you if you ask them any doubt about their subject. Many professors will also help you with extra-curricular activities. My friends are starting a startup, and they got a lot of help from professors even though they do not teach them. Thus they make students ready for the industry.
Other: IITK organises three fests, i.e., cultural fest named Antaragni, Techkriti which is Asia's hugest technical fest and entrepreneurial fest. Scholarships are provided to students whose parents annual income is less than 6 lacs. An inter-hostel competition is also organised named Galaxy, which is one of the best things for IITK students.
